prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 高一学生期中期末成绩汇总 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "姓名" spans 1 col × 2 row; "语文" spans 2 col × 1 row; "数学" spans 2 col × 1 row; "英语" spans 2 col × 1 row; "总分" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "语文 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "语文 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "数学 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "数学 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 6: header "英语 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 7: header "英语 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 8: header "总分" · longest unbreakable word 28px · one-line width 31px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总六名高一学生三科期中、期末成绩及总分，便于查看个人表现和比较成绩。","reading":"读者按行查看同一学生的成绩和总分，也会按列比较学生，并在每个学科内对照期中与期末。两层表头已有高度，可容纳子表头换行。","groups":["姓名列标识每一行，需让姓名仍容易辨认。","语文、数学、英语各由期中和期末两列组成；六个分数列作用相同，宽度应有一致的节奏。","总分列汇总各科成绩，供读者快速比较整体表现。"],"keep_intact":["两位数的单科成绩","三位数的总分","学科名称"],"may_wrap":["期中、期末子表头可在两个汉字之间换行。","学生姓名可在汉字之间换行，但完整姓名位于同一行高内更易扫描。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [53, 42, 42, 42, 42, 42, 42, 54] · table 360×454px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 6/11 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [67, 40, 40, 40, 40, 40, 40, 52] · table 360×314px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 6/11 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [51, 43, 40, 43, 40, 43, 40, 59] · table 360×593px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 7/11 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"六个成绩列等宽，三个学科的期中、期末配对清晰；单科分数、总分和学科名称均保持完整。","problems":"所有姓名都折成两行，使数据行变高，行内成绩与姓名的对应关系也不如单行姓名直观。子表头逐字换行，但在统一列宽下仍有一致的节奏。","cause":"姓名列宽53px，扣除21px后只剩32px，不足以容纳约46px的完整姓名；各成绩列宽42px，内容区仅21px，无法并排容纳期中或期末两个字。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"姓名、单科成绩和总分均完整单行显示，数据行紧凑且容易横向阅读；六个等宽成绩列让三个学科和两次考试的比较保持一致。总分列也有足够空间。","problems":"六个子表头都分成两行，阅读时需要纵向组合两个字；不过这种换行在各学科中一致，表头层级仍然清楚。","cause":"姓名列67px和总分列52px恰好分别提供46px和31px内容宽度；每个成绩列40px仅提供19px内容宽度，能容纳分数，但不足以让两个汉字并排。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"各学科仍按期中、期末成对排列，单科成绩和总分保持完整。","problems":"姓名和姓名表头逐字换行，六个数据行因此很高，姓名难以快速辨认；成绩列交替宽窄，削弱了同类列的统一节奏。总分列较宽，留白相对过多。","cause":"姓名列51px扣除内边距和边框后仅30px，不足以并排显示两个汉字；成绩列在43px与40px之间交替，总分列占59px，挤占了姓名列所需的空间。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
